uses `optimize_text_preview` instead.
- ASR (`mimo-v2.5-asr`) must **n"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"ot** receive a `thinking` field.
- `input_audio.data` / `video_url.url` accept either a public URL o"},{"id":"p28s6","text":"r a
`data:<mime>;base64,...` data URL (video base64 capped at 50MB per the docs).
- Web search costs"},{"id":"p28s7","text":" per keyword round (`max_keyword`, default 3) — see MiMo
pricing. `force_search` (default true) trad"},{"id":"p28s8","text":"es freshness against cost;

`{"type":"approximate","country":"Ch"},{"id":"p28s9","text":"ina","region":"Hubei","city":"Wuhan"}`.
